notes:
Lead came in via hosted API signup form — product-led inbound.
Quick company snapshot: B2B SaaS (email/inbox productivity for SMBs), building embedded in-app chat assistant that surfaces contextual help, quick replies and canned actions.
Primary ask: streaming-first chat for low-latency user experience (first token p50 < 120ms, p95 < 300ms ideally).
Scale: initial cohort ~50-150 concurrent active users; expect steady growth to 1k concurrent in 12 months. Throughput ~500-1,200 reqs/min during peak. Cost-sensitive but willing to pay for latency.
Model preferences: prefer lightweight, open/quantized model variants for cost (LLaMA2-flavors or similar) with option to route heavy queries to higher-quality hosted models. Asked about Redwood's model catalog and verified streaming profiles.
Routing/fallback: want automatic fallback to higher-latency but higher-accuracy model for multi-step flows; also prefer region routing (NA primary, EU secondary later).
Security/compliance: SOC2 required, SSO (SAML) for internal access, audit logs for usage, 90d retention policy for logs. No on-prem requirement — public cloud ok.

 - Deliver short writeup with recommendations (quantization profile, batching window, model variant suggestions).
